tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background for every section. Dark is the default — the late-night chair look.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards (portfolio, testimonials), the booking block, the sticky book bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Footer ground and image placeholders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (16:1+ both themes). Also the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy — subtitles, cut meta, hours — on surface and surface-raised (6.6:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary button fill, highlight word, stars, eyebrows. As text on surface / surface-raised / brass-soft ≥4.9:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Label text on a brass fill (primary buttons, selected slot chips). 6:1+ both themes.

tokens.name: brass-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind the booking CTA and rating pills. Ink or brass text on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card edges only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (secondary buttons, slot chips): 3.3:1+ on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: pole-red
tokens.usage: Barber-pole stripe only. Never text, never a status.

tokens.name: pole-blue
tokens.usage: Barber-pole stripe only. Never text, never a link.

tokens.name: pole-white
tokens.usage: Barber-pole stripe ground.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline on phones; scales to 104px at ≥1024px and 120px at ≥1440px. Uppercase.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Card titles, the barber's name in the footer. Uppercase.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: One barber, one chair, your full attention.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Precision cuts, hot-towel shaves and beard work.
styles.usage: Default copy. Never below 16px on inputs (prevents iOS zoom).

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Card meta, footer lists, trust row.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Eyebrows above section titles, prices, times. Uppercase, brass or ink-muted.

spacing.note: 4px base. Mobile gutters are space-4; sections breathe with space-10 (space-12 at ≥1024px). Tablet and up (≥640px) gutters are space-6.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, star rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner gaps, button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone page gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; desktop card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Title-to-content gap; tablet and desktop gutter (≥640px).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero bottom padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Vertical section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Vertical section padding at ≥1024px.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, slot chips' inner focus, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, slot chips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, booking block, portfolio media.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Rating pill, barber pole capsule.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Portfolio and testimonial cards.

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: Sticky book bar lifting off the page.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky book bar.
